title: Configure Pololu 25D manufacturer motors and encoders
text: Use existing schematic tools: place symbolId motor_pololu_4865 (MP encoder), motor_pololu_4885 (LP encoder), motor_pololu_4845 (HP encoder) or motor_pololu_3229 (MP no encoder), then inspect/edit normal parameters. Canonical motor-dc-pololu-<part> IDs match CAD. Model shaft is gearbox OUTPUT, using the existing DC motor/shaft solver. Calibration choices: Published typical endpoints, Datasheet fitted lines, User coefficients. Derived effective R/Kt/Ke/B are not intrinsic measured constants. Default L=0 neglects winding transients and J=1e-5 is an unverified reference inertia; transient timing is uncalibrated. Published stall/gearbox/thermal limits are metadata, not safe working ratings or a damage model. M1/M2 are motor terminals. Encoder variants alone add VCC/GND/A/B: 3.5-20V powered ideal quadrature, 48 both-edge counts per motor revolution, 2248.86 per output revolution; default count-consistent ratio=2248.86/48, not rounded 46.85. Output resistance is an assumed editable 100 ohm; drive strength, quiescent current, timing and frequency limits are unverified. Choose time steps that resolve every encoder transition. Full original curves, source hashes and unknowns are retained in assets/manufacturers/pololu and assets/pololu-25d-reference.json. See docs/POLOLU_25D_MODELS.md.
